title: Tiny, cute Christmas tree
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- tree body: three stacked green triangles -->
  <polygon points="50,12 30,42 70,42" fill="#3ddc84"/>
  <polygon points="50,28 24,60 76,60" fill="#2ecc71"/>
  <polygon points="50,46 18,80 82,80" fill="#27ae60"/>
  <!-- lighter highlight layers to show edges -->
  <polygon points="50,12 30,42 70,42" fill="none" stroke="#7ef7b0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="50,28 24,60 76,60" fill="none" stroke="#6fe6a0" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="50,46 18,80 82,80" fill="none" stroke="#5fdd94" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- trunk -->
  <rect x="44" y="80" width="12" height="12" rx="2" fill="#c87a3a"/>
  <rect x="44" y="80" width="12" height="3" rx="1" fill="#e8a060"/>
  <!-- star on top -->
  <polygon points="50,2 53,9 60,9 55,14 57,21 50,17 43,21 45,14 40,9 47,9" fill="#ffe14d"/>
  <!-- ornaments -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="34" r="3" fill="#ff5c8a"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="38" r="3" fill="#5cc8ff"/>
  <circle cx="36" cy="52" r="3.2" fill="#ffe14d"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="52" r="3.2" fill="#ff5c8a"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="58" r="3" fill="#b06cff"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="68" r="3.5" fill="#5cc8ff"/>
  <circle cx="70" cy="68" r="3.5" fill="#ffe14d"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="72" r="3.5" fill="#ff5c8a"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="74" r="2.8" fill="#b06cff"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="74" r="2.8" fill="#5cc8ff"/>
</svg>
